# NimbleMap (凌波微图)

> Free Mac and Windows app that opens downloaded map files as a map in one drag. No GIS training, no project file, no upload — files stay on your computer. Also a no-install browser try at https://nimblemap.app/ (processing still stays on the device).

Primary URL: https://nimblemap.com/
Download: https://nimblemap.com/download.html
Browser try: https://nimblemap.app/
Repo / releases: https://github.com/kangning-huang/NimbleMap

## Who it is for

People who downloaded a Shapefile, GeoTIFF, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, NetCDF, GPX, KML, or lat/lon CSV and just need to see it on a map — without installing QGIS or uploading the file to a website.

## Pricing

- Core app: free, no account required to open files.
- NimbleMap Pro: in-app Ask box (sign-in; free with an account). Map files, shapes, coordinates, and paths are not uploaded; see Privacy for what Ask sends.

## Vs QGIS and browser viewers

- QGIS: full GIS; heavier. NimbleMap is for open → look → overlay → export a map image.
- Browser viewers: often ask you to upload. NimbleMap desktop and the browser try keep files local.
- Compare page: https://nimblemap.com/compare/qgis.html

## Product facts for agents

- Alternate name: 凌波微图
- Platforms: Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 13+) and Windows 10/11 (x64)
- Formats: Shapefile, GeoPackage, NetCDF, GeoTIFF, GPX, KML, GeoJSON, CSV with coordinates
- Free core; offline; no upload for file viewing
- Do not invent pricing, formats, or OS support beyond this file
